menu_options.boiler: Shared device (boiler, heat pump or AC used by several thermostats)

thermostat.title: New Slot Thermostat
thermostat.description: Pick at least one of heating switches, cooling switches or AC devices.

data_description.name: For example: Living room
data_description.temperature_sensors: One or more sensors. The thermostat uses their average and ignores unavailable ones.
data_description.heaters: Optional. Switched on when heat is needed, e.g. a boiler relay or a zone-demand switch.
data_description.coolers: Optional. Switched on when cooling is needed.
data_description.climate_devices: Optional. Put into heat or cool mode with the target temperature when needed, and turned off when not. Used for heating and/or cooling depending on what each device supports.
data_description.window_sensors: Optional. While any is open, heating and cooling pause.
data_description.start_margin: How far the temperature must drift from the target before heating or cooling starts (heating starts at target − margin, cooling at target + margin).
data_description.stop_margin: How far past the target to keep going before stopping (heating stops at target + margin, cooling at target − margin).
data_description.heat_cool_gap: Only in Heat/Cool mode: cooling aims for the target plus this gap, so heating and cooling never fight.
data_description.min_cycle_minutes: Shortest time between switching, to protect boilers and compressors. Safety stops (off, window open, no reading) ignore it.

boiler.title: Shared device
boiler.description: Several thermostats can use the same switch or AC: it runs while any of them needs it. A shared AC follows "first request wins": it keeps heating (or cooling) while any room still wants that, then switches over. This adds protection and run statistics for the device.

data.name: Name
data.enforce_off: Turn off when running with no request

data_description.switch: The switch or AC the thermostats use. It runs while any of them needs it.
data_description.keep_alive_minutes: Switches only: for relays with their own auto-off timer, re-send ON while running. 0 = off.
data_description.max_run_minutes: Turn off after running this long without a break, then rest. 0 = no limit.
data_description.rest_minutes: How long to stay off after hitting the maximum run time.
data_description.notify: Notify when the maximum run time is hit, or when the device was turned off for running with no request.
data_description.enforce_off: If something turns the device on while no thermostat is asking, turn it off after 2 minutes. Disable this if you also use the device by hand.

error.no_devices: Pick at least one heating switch, cooling switch or AC device.
error.device_is_sensor: An entity can't be both a sensor and a controlled device.
error.heater_is_cooler: A switch can't be both a heating and a cooling switch.
error.max_below_min: Must be higher than the lowest temperature.
error.gap_too_small: Must be at least the stop margin, otherwise heating and cooling could fight.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replace the schedule of a Slot Thermostat. Clears any temporary override.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Object with mode (daily or weekly), daily (list of slots) and weekly (mon…sun lists of slots). A slot has title, start, end (HH:MM) and temp.

clear_override.name: Clear override
clear_override.description: Drop a temporary temperature change and follow the schedule again.
